name: cold_snap
description: THE PROOF THAT AUTOMATION IS LOAD-BEARING. Every command in this file is one a player's mouse produces: the whole factory goes up through {system: build}, the same path PlayController turns a click and a drag into. A coal generator, a pipe and a radiator are built; a crate of four hundred coal sits ten tiles west of it, beside the city core and below the narrative card so the visual run photographs it; a loading arm lifts coal onto a dragged belt line, the line runs east, and a second arm shovels it into the generator's bunker. The city's own coal is set to zero on tick one, so every lump that burns physically came down that belt. At tick 900 ONE belt tile is demolished, exactly what pressing X on it does, and nothing else changes. Then read the run: heat.total_supply holds around 19 while the bunker coasts, and is 0.00 from tick ~3500 to the end; heat.avg_warmth falls 9.06 -> 4.43 -> -0.01; logistics.fuel_by_machine stops climbing at 33 the moment the line is cut; logistics.lines_dry goes to 1; and logistics.hauled_total is 0 for the entire run, which is the number that proves no porter quietly covered for the mistake. Coordinates are for seed 7 and were found by tests/logistics/build_probe.gd searching for buildable ground, not guessed. It lives here rather than in tests/scenarios/ because that folder is generated by tools/gen_scenarios.py and belongs to [P00].
